snippet.title: Forgotten Hill Pico - Walkthrough
snippet.description:
Can you bring Pico back to its cage? Here's a complete walkthrough to help you!
Forgotten Hill Pico, a new adventure made with the fantasy console Pico-8 by Lexaloffle game, is available here: https://www.forgotten-hill.com/game/forgotten-hill-pico/
Pico-8 is a fantasy virtual console made by Lexaloffle Games that emulates the hardware limitation of the 1980s game machines. All game are therefore limited to 128x128px display, 16 colors and 4 channel audio, making games is so challenging! We've had a lot of fun making Forgotten Hill Pico, let us know if you like it!
For more information about Pico-8, visit https://www.lexaloffle.com/pico-8.php
